integrity: The proof uses the general contact-convex-hull certificate for minimum enclosing balls and derives the source-family structure from scratch. Base-only contacts give a reciprocal-square threshold; when the apex is forced active, two linear KKT equations yield the closed K and apex-weight formulas, while monotonicity in the sorted base weights proves that every positive base support is a tail. Independent finite verification enumerates generic contact subsets using exact rational arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the standard coordinate realization of the weighted terminal simplices S(omega). It determines the ordinary Euclidean minimum enclosing sphere, not lattice covering radii, Euclidean inradii, extremal ellipsoids, or invariants under non-orthogonal unimodular changes. A broader diagonally structured-simplex theorem under different terminology remains a residual originality risk.
title: Weighted terminal simplices have a sorted active-set formula for their minimum enclosing sphere
